title: OpenWOP v1→v2 event-type codemap
description: Shape of spec/v1/event-codemap.json (v2 charter C.4/C.9, Phase 1 item 9): one row per RunEventType with its payload $def and a proposed v2 name. Data, not a wire artifact; kept out of schemas/. Generated by scripts/generate-event-codemap.mjs; the v2 C.4 child RFC edits it and every host backfills its event log from it.

v2Override.description: Hand-decided v2 name (C.4 decision); wins over the mechanical proposal and survives regeneration.

review.description: true when the mechanical proposal needs a semantic decision (tense, domain rename, reserved prefix).

notes.description: GENERATED by scripts/generate-event-codemap.mjs and rewritten on every `--write`: the mechanical reasons the v2 NAME differs from the v1 one (segments folded, case or separator normalised, tense not past). Naming only.

note.description: HAND-WRITTEN and preserved across `--write`: why this NAME may depart from `events.md` §Naming's `domain.verb-ed` convention. NAMING RATIONALE ONLY — never a statement about the event's semantics or payload. "artifact event" names the RFC 0171 §A.2 exception category in which the past-tense rule is relaxed and a noun form is permitted; it does NOT mean the event is about artifacts. Read beside `notes`: different provenance, neither complete alone.
